name: How long does basement painting usually take?

mainEntity.name: How long does basement painting usually take?

acceptedAnswer.text: The duration of a basement painting project depends on the size of the basement, the amount of prep work required (cleaning, repairs, priming), and the drying time between coats. A small to medium-sized basement with minimal prep might take 2-4 days, including drying times. Larger basements or those requiring extensive repairs or specialized coatings could take a week or more. We aim to complete projects efficiently while ensuring a high-quality finish.
acceptedAnswer.description: Basement painting typically takes 2-4 days for a small to medium space, but can extend longer for larger basements or extensive prep work.
